evidence.title: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, its answer to Meta and OpenAI's personal agents
evidence.body: [e001:f01] The company announced the new app Claude Duet on Wednesday, billed as a "proactive agent" that can run in the background, surface tasks to a user, and handle a variety of work. [e001:f02] Anthropic is joining the personal AI agent craze. [e001:f03] The tool is in research preview for now with a waitlist, meaning it won't immediately compete for the larger market with other new agents like Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots. [e001:f04] Still, the announcement ramps up the pressure on those companies — Anthropic says it built Duet around its flagship Opus 5.5 model, which was released in late September and has already become one of the industry's most popular. [e001:f05] Recent model breakthroughs have made AI better at handling work on its own, spurring a rush to build these "always-on" personal agents. [e001:f06] "It can have the discernment and judgment around when to be proactive, when to act on your behalf," said Mike Krieger, a co-lead of Anthropic's Labs team, said in a Duet launch video. [e001:f07] The tool, Anthropic says, will send users a brief each morning about what's happening on their connected apps, and message them when something needs attention. [e001:f08] Anthropic announced Duet on the day of Meta's earnings report and used the opportunity to mention a new poach from Mark Zuckerberg's company. [e001:f09] Karan Ahuja led product management for Meta Superintelligence Labs until July, according to his LinkedIn, before starting at Anthropic in August and leading Duet's development. [e001:f10] He wrote on X that he's been using Duet to build Duet, and said the team "built it for professionals and small business owners juggling a lot at work and at home." Ahuja also wrote that Anthropic is letting people into Duet from the waitlist "as quickly as possible." The news didn't go unnoticed at Meta. [e001:f11] Alexandr Wang, who heads Meta Superintelligence Labs, posted a meme about Duet's similarity to Muse. [e001:f12] Anthropic is fast approaching a giant initial public offering, which could value the company at as much as $2 trillion. [e001:f13] Like other AI players, the company navigates a high-wire competition to win over users, secure computing power, build state-of-the-art models, and deliver AI-native products. [e001:f14] It found that Claude users who installed the Muse app were using Claude more than before, though still for fewer minutes per day than they spent on the Meta product. evidence.title: Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI agent to rival Meta's Muse, OpenAI's Dots
evidence.body: [e004:f01] [Image 4: Content media](https:// İSTANBUL US artificial intelligence company Anthropic introduced Claude Duet on Wednesday, a proactive AI agent designed to independently manage tasks on behalf of users. [e004:f02] Powered by Claude Opus 5.5, the assistant targets professionals and small business owners, offering daily briefings and handling tasks ranging from scheduling meetings to preparing financial forecasts and building web applications. [e004:f03] "Claude Duet comes to you with what needs your attention, completes tasks you ask of it, keeps working even when you step away, and checks with you before it acts on your behalf," Anthropic said in its announcement. [e004:f04] The agent operates through a browser-equipped virtual machine, allowing it to continue working even when users' devices are switched off, according to the company. [e004:f05] Anthropic said Claude Duet requires user approval before sending messages, making payments, signing documents or deleting information. [e004:f06] The company also introduced safeguards against unauthorized disclosure of sensitive data, including credit card numbers and government identification details. [e004:f07] Anthropic opened a waitlist Wednesday for a research preview of Claude Duet, initially limited to Pro and Max subscribers in the US. [e004:f08] The company has yet to announce when the assistant will become more widely available. [e004:f09] The launch follows Meta's introduction of Muse and OpenAI's Dots in September, as major AI companies compete to develop proactive assistants capable of performing tasks on users' behalf. evidence.title: OpenAI、ChatGPT広告を26カ国へ拡大 広告主は10万社超
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 広告提供の開始から8カ月余りで、キャンペーンを実施した広告主は10万社を超えた。 [e002:f02] 今回の拡大では、アルゼンチン、チリ、コロンビア、ペルーなど中南米の14カ国に加え、ナイジェリア、南アフリカ、セルビア、ウクライナ、カンボジア、バングラデシュ、パキスタンなどで提供を開始。 [e002:f03] 広告主は、テクノロジーパートナー経由、または広告マネージャーのセルフサービス機能を使って出稿できる。 [e002:f04] ChatGPT広告は、ユーザーが会話を通じて商品やサービスを探し、比較・検討する場面で、関連する選択肢を提示するもの。 [e002:f05] 広告の表示対象はFreeとGoプランで、Plus、Pro、Enterpriseには引き続き表示しない。 [e002:f06] 広告には広告であることを明示し、ChatGPTの回答と分けて表示する。 [e002:f07] また、広告が回答内容に影響することはなく、会話を広告主に開示したり、ユーザーのデータを販売したりすることもないとしている。 [e002:f08] 今後は、広告フォーマットやキャンペーンの目的、広告購入オプション、効果測定機能を拡充。 [e002:f09] ChatGPTの利用体験に自然に組み込める広告のあり方も検討する。

evidence.title: オープンAI、ChatGPT広告を新たに26か国へ拡大 計89か国に、広告主は10万社を超える
evidence.body: [e005:f01] ChatGPT広告、新たに26か国へ拡大 （出典： オープンAI ） オープンAIは10月21日、ChatGPTの広告事業「ChatGPT Ads」の提供地域を新たに26か国へ広げ、世界89か国で利用できるようになったと、 公式ブログ で発表した。 [e005:f02] 広告の提供を始めてから8か月余りで、ChatGPTでキャンペーンを実施した広告主は10万社を超えたという。 [e005:f03] 広告表示はFreeとGoの両プランのみ。 [e005:f04] 同社は、毎週12億人以上がChatGPTを使って選択肢を探り、比較し、意思決定を行っているとしている。 [e005:f05] メキシコとブラジルでの提供開始に続く展開となる。 [e005:f06] 今回の発表は、8月の欧州、 9月の東南アジアと台湾への拡大 に続くものだ。 [e005:f07] これらの国の広告主は、テクノロジーパートナーを通じて、または広告マネージャーのセルフサービス機能を使って、ChatGPT広告を利用できる。 [e005:f08] 広告が表示されるのは、FreeプランとGoプランのみ。 [e005:f09] Plus、Pro、Enterpriseのサブスクリプションでは、引き続き広告は表示されない。 [e005:f10] 同社は、会話を広告主に開示することも、顧客のデータを販売することもなく、広告は広告であることが明示され、ChatGPTの回答とは分けて表示されると説明している。 [e005:f11] 広告がChatGPTの回答に影響することもないという。 [e005:f12] 発表にはロレアルグループのCDMO、アスミタ・デュベイ氏のコメントも盛り込まれた。 [e005:f13] では、米国のテストから8か月で89か国に達したChatGPT広告は、どんな順序で広がってきたのか。 [e005:f14] 背景には、8月に導入済みの入札・計測の仕組みと、国内の代理店各社の存在がある。 [e005:f15] 【画像解説と記事全文はこちら】ChatGPT広告、拡大の歩み ChatGPT広告、拡大の歩み （出典：オープンAIの発表をもとに作成） この記事の続き ＞＞ ・米国テストから89か国へ、拡大の順序と加速の度合い ・8月に整った入札と計測の仕組みの中身 ・日本の広告主が使える入口と、代理店5社の顔ぶれ この続きは 会員限定（完全無料）です ここから先は「ビジネス+IT」会員に登録された方のみ、ご覧いただけます。 [e005:f16] ここでしか見られない 2万本超のオリジナル記事・動画・資料が見放題！

evidence.title: OpenAI Adds Locked Chats to ChatGPT and Acquires Orchestra Bio to Strengthen Life Sciences AI
evidence.body: [e003:f01] [Image 2: James Dargan](https:// [James Dargan](https:// 21 October 2026 _·_ 2 min read ! [e003:f02] [Image 3: a purple and green background with intertwined circles](https:// OpenAI announced two moves on Tuesday, introducing a privacy feature that lets ChatGPT users lock conversations and acquiring AI biotech software startup Orchestra Bio to support its life sciences ambitions. [e003:f03] The new Locked Chats feature allows users to protect sensitive conversations with a four-digit PIN, or with Face ID or Touch ID on supported devices. [e003:f04] Unlike Temporary Chats, which run as separate sessions outside chat history, locked conversations can be revisited at any time. [e003:f05] OpenAI said the feature is intended for situations such as discussing personal matters or planning a surprise, where users may hand their device to friends or family. [e003:f06] Locked conversations move to a dedicated section, separate from regular history, pinned chats and search results. [e003:f07] When Memory is enabled, the section keeps its own shared memory, so new information from locked chats does not carry into regular conversations. [e003:f08] OpenAI noted that locking does not provide end-to-end encryption or a separate encrypted vault, alter how long chats are retained, remove information remembered before locking, or change the model improvement setting. [e003:f09] The option is not available for temporary, archived, group or shared-link chats, or those with scheduled tasks or meeting recordings. [e003:f10] Locked Chats is rolling out to Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu users, but not ChatGPT for Healthcare. [e003:f11] The addition comes as ChatGPT is increasingly used for personal conversations, though it does not address broader concerns about how sensitive data is stored. [e003:f12] In other company news, OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio, a four-year-old startup that builds AI agents to help biotech companies handle drug discovery operations, from tracking finances to resolving clinical trial scheduling. [e003:f13] Terms were not disclosed, though Orchestra had reportedly raised around $20 million as of 2025 from investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Atria and 8VC. [e003:f14] OpenAI said Orchestra’s team and technology will support Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and the related Rosalind Workbench, a harness designed to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results. [e003:f15] The deal reflects how leading AI labs, notably OpenAI and Anthropic, are building more software for major industries such as pharmaceuticals. evidence.title: 2027 Honda CBR500R FOUR Announced For Europe
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Honda announced the CBR500R FOUR for the European market, bringing a new entry point to the brand’s larger four-cylinder sportbikes, and a sportier alternative to Honda’s own Twin-cylinder CBR500R. [e004:f02] Add Motorcycle as a Preferred Source on Google The CBR500R FOUR originally debuted in China earlier this year alongside a naked CB500 Super Four model. [e004:f03] While the Kawasaki Ninja ZX-4R and ZX-4RR might be its most obvious rival, the CBR500R FOUR’s debut in China tells us Honda is also throwing a gauntlet against bikes such as the CFMOTO 500SR, Kove 450RR, and ZXMoto 500RR. [e004:f04] Honda has an advantage in billing the CBR500R FOUR as a gateway to the CBR650R, CBR600RR and CBR1000RR, larger sportbikes with a stronger lineage than any offerings from these Chinese brands. [e004:f05] The CBR500R FOUR is powered by a new 502cc DOHC 16-valve inline-Four, with Honda claiming peak performance figures of 71 hp at 11,000 rpm and 35 lb-ft. at 9,750 rpm, with a redline of 12,500 rpm. [e004:f06] That’s a much lower rev limit than the FOUR’s direct competitors, with most of them not even reaching their peak power output until at least 13,500 rpm. [e004:f07] In this context, it’s easy to see how the FOUR fits between the parallel-Twin CBR500R, which claims 47 hp and 32 lb-ft., and the CBR650R (94 hp and 46.5 lb-ft.). [e004:f08] Like these two other bikes, the CBR500R FOUR comes standard with Honda’s semi-automatic E-Clutch system. [e004:f09] The CBR500R FOUR uses a ride-by-wire throttle, with three pre-programmed modes and two user-defined modes, and the E-Clutch automatically adjusts the throttle butterfly opening range depending on the riding mode. [e004:f10] Honda designed a new steel tube diamond-style frame for the CBR500R Four, with the engine serving as a stressed member. [e004:f11] The braking system consists of dual Nissin radial-mount two-piston calipers and 296mm discs for the front wheel, and a single-piston caliper and 240mm disc for the rear wheel. [e004:f12] At just 30.7 inches from the ground, the seat is at a relatively low height for a sportbike, even compared to the Twin-cylinder CBR500R’s 30.9-inch seat height. [e004:f13] The 2027 CBR500R will be available in two colors: Ignition Red (Tricolor) or Mat Ballistic Black Metallic. [e004:f14] In the U.K., Honda is pricing the CBR500R FOUR at £6,999, which is just slightly more expensive than the £6,899 CBR500R twin-cylinder model, but well below the £8,799 CBR650R. [e004:f15] As of this writing, there are no indications that Honda would bring the CBR500R FOUR to the U.S., but if it did, we can probably expect pricing to come in somewhere around US$7,000. [e004:f16] 2027 Honda CBR500R FOUR Specifications Engine Type Liquid cooled 16-valve DOHC, inline-Four, 16 valves Displacement 502cc Bore x Stroke 60.0 mm x 44.4 mm Compression Ratio 12.3:1 Horsepower 71 hp at 11,000 rpm (claimed) Torque 35 lb-ft. at 9,750 rpm (claimed) Fueling PGM FI electronic fuel injection Clutch Type E-Clutch with wet multiplate & assisted slipper clutch Transmission 6 gears Final Drive Chain Frame Type Steel Frame Type Steel tube diamond-style frame Front Suspension 41mm KYB inverted fork with 4.9 inches of travel Rear Suspension Preload-adjustable monoshock operating thorugh Pro-Link, 4.7 inches of travel Front Brake Dual Nissin radial-mount two-piston calipers with 296mm discs Rear Brake Single Nissin single-piston caliper with a 240mm disc ABS Two-channel Front Wheel Cast aluminum 17M/C x MT3.5 Rear Wheel Cast aluminum 17M/C x MT4.5 Front Tire Pirelli Diablo Rosso IV 120/70/ZR17 Rear Tire Pirelli Diablo Rosso IV 160/60/ZR17 Rake/Trail 25° / 3.9 inches Wheelbase 55.6 inches Length 81.0 inches Width 29.7 inches Height 44.3 inches Seat Height 30.7 inches Curb Weight 417 pounds (claimed) 2027 Honda CBR500R Four First Look Gallery View Gallery 25 photos Credit: Photos by Honda.

evidence.body: [e005:f01] 今回のデザインは、2021年に始まった両社の協力関係を祝うもので、サーキット・オブ・ジ・アメリカズでのレースに限定して使用される。 [e005:f02] コグニザントは、アストンマーティンが2021年にF1へ復帰した際にパートナーとして参画した企業のひとつだ。 [e005:f03] それ以来、チームの変革期を通じて協力… 9時間前 アストンマーティンF1がホンダ参戦500戦を祝福 アメリカGPでニューウェイら記念撮影 アストンマーティンF1チームは、2026年F1アメリカGPでF1参戦通算500戦の節目を迎えるテクニカルパートナーのホンダに祝福のメッセージを送った。 [e005:f04] 記念ロゴをマシンに掲出するほか、フェルナンド・アロンソ、ランス・ストロール、エイドリアン・ニューウェイらが参加する記念撮影も予定されている。 [e005:f05] ホンダのF1への挑戦は、1964年のドイツGPから始まった。 [e005:f06] その後、シャシーとエンジンの両方を開発するフルワークスチーム、エンジンサプライヤー、パワ… 2026年10月21日 16:09 ホンダF1 アメリカGPで参戦通算500戦達成へ アストンマーティンに記念ロゴ ホンダは、2026年F1第18戦アメリカGPで、1964年の初参戦から通算500戦という歴史的な節目を迎えることを発表した。 [e005:f07] これを記念し、アストンマーティンF1チームのマシン「AMR26」に特別な「Honda500記念ロゴ」を掲出するほか、HRCエンジニアの特別ユニフォームや記念グッズの販売など、さまざまな企画を展開する。 [e005:f08] 車体とエンジンを自社開発するフルワークス体制、エンジンサプ… 2026年10月20日 17:36 フェルナンド・アロンソ ホンダF1の新たなPU問題を指摘「多くのタイムを失っている」 フェルナンド・アロンソは、2026年F1シンガポールGPでアストンマーティンのホンダ製パワーユニット（PU）に新たな問題が発生していたと指摘し、原因究明を求めた。 [e005:f09] すでに明らかになっているエネルギーのデプロイメント不調に加え、ドライバビリティやターボラグにも問題があり、ラップタイムを大きく失っていたという。 [e005:f10] アロンソはシンガポールGP決勝後、などのメディアに対し、ホンダPUが本来のパフォーマンスを発揮できていなかっ… 2026年10月20日 12:37 通知を受け取る 最新ニュースをいち早くお届けします YouTube Shorts YouTubeで開く @F1Gate のチャンネル。

evidence.title: Lance Stroll offers damning Honda verdict in Aston Martin update
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Lance Stroll did not attempt to sugarcoat his appraisal of Honda's latest power unit upgrade for Aston Martin, which was quietly delivered at the Spanish Grand Prix. [e001:f02] Article To news overview © XPB Images Lance Stroll has delivered a blunt assessment of Honda's second ADUO engine upgrade, introduced quietly at the Madring in Spain, while expressing cautious optimism over Aston Martin's chassis direction for 2027. [e001:f03] The Canadian, who has been confirmed at the Silverstone-based outfit for next season, said he expects the AMR27 to mark a clear step forward on the aerodynamic side. [e001:f04] But he admitted the power unit situation remains the biggest unknown heading into the new regulations cycle. [e001:f05] Honda's second Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities package was fitted to Stroll's car in Spain, following the first ADUO update introduced at Zandvoort in August, which focused on reshaping the combustion chamber and pre-chamber and reducing internal friction through a revised lubrication system. [e001:f06] That update arrived after Honda was found to be trailing the leading internal combustion benchmark by more than four per cent, qualifying the manufacturer for two additional in-season upgrades under the FIA's concession mechanism. [e001:f07] Aston Martin's own in-season progress has been more visible, with a sweeping 16-part upgrade at the Hungaroring in July bringing a reprofiled nose, revised floor and diffuser, and a reworked rear wing aimed at unlocking more underfloor performance and allowing higher rear ride heights. [e001:f08] That work, although a clear step forward, has yet to translate into consistent results, with the team languishing tenth in the constructors' standings on seven points. [e001:f09] Asked what he has been told about the 2027 car, Stroll struck an upbeat tone over the chassis. [e001:f10] "We have a plan, a good direction. [e001:f11] "We don't know how we're going to be in the beginning of '27, so we'll see..." [Article continues below] Driver Lance Stroll Canadian Aston Martin 18 News Results Statistics Stroll: 'A lot of work to be done' with Honda That uncertainty hardened into criticism when Stroll was pressed on whether the Madring update, Honda's second ADUO intervention of the season, had moved the needle. [e001:f12] We know that, so a lot of work to be done." Honda has already undergone an internal reshuffle in response to the shortfall, with Yoichiro Fukao placed in charge of the programme at the start of October. [e001:f13] The manufacturer has acknowledged its power unit development was delayed by roughly two years due to a late decision to re-enter Formula 1 as a works supplier, leaving it chasing rivals on the FIA's ADUO index. evidence.title: Fernando Alonso calls for Honda investigation amid ongoing complaints
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Fernando Alonso has continued to voice concerns over the Honda power unit powering the Aston Martin Formula 1 car. [e002:f02] Singapore posed another tough weekend for the Silverstone-based team, which has spent the new regulations at the back of the field. [e002:f03] Although the team have worked hard to improve the car for both Lance Stroll and Alonso, the results have been slow ot come. [e002:f04] The Spaniard has been closest to results, narrowly missing Q2 in Singapore. [e002:f05] However, in race situations, the Aston Martin drivers have increasingly found themselves off the pace and frustrated. [e002:f06] After the race, Alonso said: “There is something on the power unit, yes, that is not performing as it should this weekend.” “We need to understand why, because obviously there are a couple of tough races coming. [e002:f07] Mexico will be the next one with very slow-speed corners. [e002:f08] There are a couple of things that are costing us a lot of lap time, and we discovered them the hard way this weekend.” The Spaniard was asked whether the issues were specific to Marina Bay and its unique characteristics or part of a larger problem with the Honda power unit. [e002:f09] “In Sepang we had no issues, and even in Baku, Baku was very twisty and very slow, the first two sectors, and we didn’t have any issues. [e002:f10] So it seems very specific to this track, and I don’t have any answers.” Fernando Alonso has voices his concerns with the Honda PU Continued problems It wasn't just the driveability issues that plagued Aston Martin across the weekend, with Alonso struggling with his turbo. [e002:f11] “I don’t think the car knew exactly where I was in the lap because I was deploying in different places that I didn’t need, and I was not deploying on the straight, so it was a little bit frustrating. [e002:f12] “But yesterday the turbo was broken, so I had to change it.” Alonso further clarified the issues. explaining they weren't isolated to the Virtual Safety Cars. [e002:f13] “But here on the virtual, in the first one, I could have overtaken [Sergio] Perez, and I ended up not overtaking, but also losing the position with [Isack] Hadjar. [e002:f14] “Then in the last virtual as well, I lost like two seconds on the restart. [e002:f15] Especially on the soft tyre, I think the first stint was very strong. [e002:f16] But we ended up behind Checo, well, behind any car, and then we lost 200, 300 metres every straight.

evidence.title: Mechanic Gets AI-Written Repair Demands After Honda CR-V Software Update
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The customer returned with concerns about unexpected braking and a lengthy diagnostic request that appeared to be written by artificial intelligence. [e003:f02] The mechanic shared the experience on Reddit's r/Justrolledintotheshop , where other technicians discussed the growing number of customers arriving with AI-generated repair instructions. [e003:f03] The vehicle owner was concerned about unintended automatic braking, a potentially serious safety issue. [e003:f04] However, the technician said they couldn't reproduce the problem during testing, making it hard to determine what was causing the behavior. [e003:f05] Advertisement Advertisement The mechanic titled the post "My fault for doing an update that pays .3," referring to a job that paid three-tenths of a labor hour. [e003:f06] What initially seemed like a straightforward software update turned into a dispute over additional diagnostics and responsibility for the vehicle's behavior. [e003:f07] In a follow-up comment, the mechanic explained that the customer had also raised the possibility of liability for both the dealership and Honda. [e003:f08] The technician said there had been no complaints about the braking problem before the recall-related software update. [e003:f09] The mechanic acknowledged the possibility but did not establish it as the cause. [e003:f10] The mechanic responded that there was no straightforward procedure for investigating some of those possibilities while driving. [e003:f11] Mechanics Push Back Several commenters described similar encounters with customers bringing AI-generated diagnostic instructions into repair shops. [e003:f12] One technician said customers increasingly request extensive testing based on online recommendations rather than describing what their vehicles are actually doing. [e003:f13] One commenter argued that customers should not have to accept unpredictable braking simply because a mechanic cannot reproduce the malfunction during a short test drive. [e003:f14] The Unresolved Problem Some commenters recommended asking the Honda owner to document the exact circumstances surrounding the braking incidents, including road conditions, location, and time of day. [e003:f15] The customer reported a potentially dangerous problem, while the mechanic had no confirmed failure to diagnose. [e003:f16] The technician was willing to investigate the braking complaint but wanted a clearer description of the symptoms rather than an extensive list of AI-generated tests.

evidence.body: [e004:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e004:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e004:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e004:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e004:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e004:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e004:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e004:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e004:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e004:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e004:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: Honda backs Thrive’s fractional launch with refurbished HondaJets
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Honda Aircraft is backing Thrive Aviation’s move into fractional ownership with a minority investment and refurbished HondaJets, as the Las Vegas operator launches a program offering shares in HondaJets and Bombardier Challenger 3500s. [e005:f02] Honda Aircraft President and CEO Hideto Yamasaki said the deal closed over the summer after several years of discussions and due diligence. [e005:f03] Under the partnership, announced in September 2026, Honda subsidiary Arulean Air will acquire aircraft while Thrive manages flight operations and customer accounts. [e005:f04] Thrive displayed the program’s first HondaJet and Challenger 3500 at NBAA-BACE 2026 in Las Vegas. [e005:f05] The company plans to begin operations on the West Coast, with a goal of adding four to six HondaJets and two to four Challenger 3500s annually as demand grows. [e005:f06] Thrive will sell shares in both the HondaJet and Challenger 3500, covering the light-jet and super-midsize categories. [e005:f07] Customers will also have access to Thrive’s existing fleet of about 30 aircraft. [e005:f08] Thrive Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer Curtis Edenfield showed off the refurbished HondaJet at Henderson Executive Airport during NBAA-BACE 2026, expressing enthusiasm for the company’s expansion into fractional ownership. [e005:f09] Honda Aircraft refurbished the jet with fresh exterior paint and new leather upholstery. [e005:f10] Honda Aircraft also sells pre-owned HondaJets and offers interior refurbishment, performance and avionics upgrades. [e005:f11] Jets sold through its Certified Pre-Owned program undergo an inspection covering more than 208 points and required maintenance, and come with a 12-month extended airframe warranty and an initial pilot type-rating course. [e005:f12] It owns about 10 aircraft and manages another 20, with a fleet ranging from Citation light jets to large-cabin Gulfstreams. [e005:f13] For Honda, the investment comes as it develops the larger, longer-range HondaJet Echelon with fractional operators among its intended customers, Yamasaki said. [e005:f14] Edenfield expressed interest in the Echelon but declined to discuss plans for including it in Thrive’s fractional program. [e005:f15] Honda is designing the Echelon to fly 2,625 nautical miles with one pilot and four passengers, with seating configurations accommodating up to 11 occupants. [e005:f16] Honda is targeting a first flight in 2028 and certification and first delivery in 2031, citing supplier-related schedule adjustments and continuing development work.

evidence.title: Aston Martin announces first-of-its-kind F1 partnership ahead of US GP
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Aston Martin has partnered with Padeltek to launch a range of branded padel rackets and accessories ahead of the United States Grand Prix Aston Martin has become the first Formula 1 team to partner with a padel and pickleball company, teaming up with Padeltek for a range of rackets that will go on sale this week. [e002:f02] The Silverstone outfit announced the new collaboration ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix in Austin, Texas, where the team and Padeltek will host an exclusive I / AM fan event at a brand-new padel venue, Padel Society. [e002:f03] The Aston Martin Padeltek collection will include three padel rackets and three cover bags. [e002:f04] "Formula 1 is a platform for collaboration across wider sport and lifestyle spaces, and we're continuing to see the growing demand from fans to bring the worlds together," Aston Martin head of licensing and merchandise Matt Chapman explained. [e002:f05] "As the first Formula 1 team to formally partner with a padel and pickleball company, we're excited to combine our brand DNA via a tangible product that feels authentic and performance-driven." Ron Saslow, founding and managing partner of Thirty-5 Capital, added: "It didn't take long for padel and Formula 1 to find each other. [e002:f06] Both sports reward precision, speed and performance, and both are attracting a growing fan base here in the United States. [e002:f07] "For Padeltek, collaborating with the Aston Martin Aramco Formula 1 Team is an opportunity to bring that shared energy to the court, creating equipment that gives racing fans a new way to connect with their team while introducing more people to padel." The partnership will continue to expand in 2027, with pickleball rackets and accessories planned for release. [e002:f08] Padel has become increasingly popular among F1 drivers, with many now incorporating it into their training routines. [e002:f09] Aston Martin heads into the United States Grand Prix, which is scheduled for 23-25 October, 10th in the constructors' standings with seven points. [e002:f10] Two-time champion Fernando Alonso is 17th in the drivers' championship, having earned all seven of the team's points, and his team-mate Lance Stroll is 21st with no points.

evidence.title: FIA president issues update on timeframe for mooted F1 V8 agreement
evidence.body: [e003:f01] FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem wants to bring back V8 engines and their iconic engine sound a year earlier than scheduled to Formula 1 , but he needs manufacturer backing to fast-track the 2030 shift. [e003:f02] Just a few months after the introduction of Formula 1’s current power unit regulations, the FIA is already planning its next engine overhaul. [e003:f03] While rumours originally pointed to 2031 for a return to V8 engines, the FIA now aims to bring them and their iconic sound back a year earlier, in 2030. [e003:f04] Since the introduction of the new regulations, drivers have had to adapt their driving style significantly to manage electrical deployment, which now plays a central role in wheel-to-wheel racing. [e003:f05] Following backlash over the initial 50/50 electric-to-thermal power split, the FIA had already agreed to adjust the hybrid ratio to 58/42 in 2027, followed by 60/40 in 2028. [e003:f06] V8 power has not been seen in F1 since 2013, but FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem is keen for them to be back in the sport FIA targets 2030 return for F1 V8 engines Speaking on the sidelines of the official announcement of the Rwandan Grand Prix, Ben Sulayem promised that “it will be agreed, because then there will not be a V8, maybe a V16 if they don’t take a V8, and they know that,” he noted. [e003:f07] For the proposal to go ahead prior to 2031, the FIA president must secure the backing of at least four of the six power unit manufacturers. [e003:f08] We consulted a driver about it.” The Emirati noted that official updates could be expected soon. [e003:f09] This means that any new regulations must be ratified shortly if a 2030 target is to be met. [e003:f10] Towards cheaper, smaller, lighter F1 cars Beyond addressing complaints about artificial racing dynamics under the current hybrid split, Ben Sulayem is aiming for simpler, lighter, and cheaper cars. [e003:f11] This continues the trend started by removing the complex MGU-H from the regulations. [e003:f12] Certain materials can be very expensive if you’re trying to get those last few horsepower.” “But lighter also means a problem for them because then some teams will have to pay more. [e003:f13] “I mean, if they come back, they will not approve only the technical data. [e003:f14] They will also approve the time required. [e003:f15] It is doable for them.” Bringing back the iconic V8 roar Ultimately, the proposed shift aims to bring back an element many fans feel has been missing since the end of the V8 era in 2013: the noise. [e003:f16] Then a very light car, but you have to be very careful about how light you can let it be.” If ratified, the move would cap the current power unit regulations at a four-season lifespan before F1 transitions into its next engine era.

evidence.title: ホンダF1 アメリカGPで参戦通算500戦達成へ アストンマーティンに記念ロゴ
evidence.body: [e005:f01] これを記念し、アストンマーティンF1チームのマシン「AMR26」に特別な「Honda500記念ロゴ」を掲出するほか、HRCエンジニアの特別ユニフォームや記念グッズの販売など、さまざまな企画を展開する。 [e005:f02] ホンダのF1参戦は、1964年のドイツGPから始まった。 [e005:f03] 2026年からはアストンマーティンF1チームにパワーユニット「RA626H」を供給し、ワークスパートナーとして新たな挑戦を開始。 [e005:f04] アストンマーティンF1のAMR26に「Honda500記念ロゴ」 10月23日から25日に米国テキサス州オースティンのサーキット・オブ・ジ・アメリカズで開催されるF1アメリカGPでは、アストンマーティンのAMR26に特別な「Honda500記念ロゴ」が掲出される。 [e005:f05] このロゴは、1964年から続くホンダのF1への挑戦と、通算500戦という歴史的な節目を象徴するものだ。 [e005:f06] 車体とエンジンを自社開発するフルワークス体制で挑戦を開始し、翌1965年のメキシコGPではRA272を駆るリッチー・ギンサーが初優勝を達成した。 [e005:f07] ウイリアムズとのパートナーシップでは1986年にコンストラクターズタイトルを獲得し、1987年にはドライバーズとコンストラクターズのダブルタイトルを達成した。 [e005:f08] さらに、1988年から1991年にかけてはマクラーレン・ホンダとして4年連続でダブルタイトルを獲得。 [e005:f09] 2018年からトロロッソ、2019年からレッドブル・レーシングへの供給を開始し、2021年にはマックス・フェルスタッペンとともにドライバーズタイトルを獲得した。 [e005:f10] この期間にレッドブルは2022年と2023年のダブルタイトルを獲得し、フェルスタッペンは2024年にドライバーズタイトル4連覇を達成した。 [e005:f11] そして2026年、ホンダはアストンマーティンとのワークスパートナーシップによってF1に本格復帰。 [e005:f12] 新たなパワーユニットレギュレーションの下で開発したRA626Hとともに、新時代への挑戦を開始している。 [e005:f13] 「1964年の初参戦から、F1という世界最高峰の舞台で数々の挑戦と挫折、そして歓喜の瞬間を重ね、このたび通算500戦という大きな節目を迎えられることをうれしく思います」 「これまでHondaの挑戦を支え、いかなる時も熱い声援を送ってくださった世界中のファンの皆様、共に戦ったすべてのパートナー、ドライバーの皆様、ならびに今まさに一丸となって挑戦を続けているAston Martin Aramco Formula One Teamに心より感謝申し上げます」 「Honda/HRCは、500戦という数字に刻まれた歴史の重みと誇りを胸に、皆様に夢と感動をお届けできるよう、これからもF1への挑戦を続けてまいります」 500戦記念動画と特設サイトを公開 記念グッズも販売 ホンダは通算500戦を記念し、1964年のドイツGPから現在までの歩みを振り返る特設ウェブサイトを公開した。 [e005:f14] さらに、アメリカGPでHRCのレースエンジニアが着用する特別ユニフォームと同じデザインを採用した、ミズノ製の500戦記念レプリカユニフォームも販売される。 [e005:f15] なお、ホンダが今回発表した通算500戦は、エンジンまたはパワーユニットの登録名称が「Honda」であり、公式予選を通過して決勝への出走権利を獲得したグランプリを対象としている。 [e005:f16] 幾度もの撤退と復帰を経験しながらF1への挑戦を続けてきたホンダは、アストンマーティンとの新たなパートナーシップの下で、記念すべき500戦目を迎える。

evidence.title: FIAがWRC27の追加規定を正式承認。2種類のラリーカーがトップカテゴリーを戦う時代へ
evidence.body: [e007:f01] 2種類のラリーカーがトップカテゴリーを戦う時代へ RALLY PLUS · 2026-10-20 ©FIA FIAは10月19日、ワールドモータースポーツカウンシルでの決定事項を発表。 [e007:f02] WRCについては、2027年からのWRC27規定の導入に先立ち、追加規定を承認。 [e007:f03] 選手権への参加資格、カテゴリー構成、ポイント配分など、2027年以降の選手権の運営に関する主要な要素が正式に承認された。 [e007:f04] 新しい規則では、これまでのラリー1カテゴリーは、WRC27技術規則に基づいて製造された新仕様の「WRCカー」と、既存のラリー2マシンをベースに、新しいフロントフェンダー、フロントバンパー、リヤエアロデバイスで構成される公認エアロダイナミクス・アップグレードキットを装着した「WRCキットカー」の両方で構成される。 [e007:f05] 27年からは、両仕様がWRCトップカテゴリーで競い合うことになる。 [e007:f06] 新ラリー1カテゴリーの導入に伴い、27年からは選手権の構造も改訂される。 [e007:f07] マニュファクチャラーズ選手権は、新たにコンストラクターズ選手権と名称を変更し、伝統的な自動車メーカーと独立系チューナーの両方が同一の部門でタイトルを争うことになる。 [e007:f08] コンストラクターズ選手権のタイトルを獲得する資格を得るため、コンストラクターはシーズンの全戦への参加が求められる。 [e007:f09] また、新しく「WRCチームズ選手権」も創設され、こちらは必須のヨーロッパ外ラウンドおよびシーズン最終戦を含む7戦への出場が求められる。 [e007:f10] コンストラクターズ選手権とWRCチームズ選手権はいずれも、ラリー1カテゴリーに属する車両のみが対象となる。 [e007:f11] サポートカテゴリーもWRC2、WRC3、およびWRCマスターズカップのドライバーズ選手権が2027年も継続される。 [e007:f12] さらに、新規格のWRCカーおよびWRCキットカーの両方において、ターボリストリクターの最大直径が32mmから33mmに拡大され、ラリー1カテゴリーで競う両規格のエンジン性能が向上する。 [e007:f13] FIA 承認された規定では、仕様車両の適切な性能差を維持するために、必要に応じてFIAが技術的またはスポーツ的な措置を導入することも認められている。 [e007:f14] 柔軟性を持たせることにより、27〜28年のシーズンの間での新規則への移行を支え、新仕様のWRCカーと改良されたWRCキットカーが並行して競い合うなかでも、選手権のトップカテゴリーの競争力を維持させる狙いだ。 [e007:f15] タグ: C3 FIA WRC WRC2 全日本ラリー高山 特設ページ ダンロップ欧州ラリーへの挑戦。

evidence.title: ライカとF1がライセンスパートナーシップを締結。『ライカQ3 43』のF1仕様が販売開始
evidence.body: [e008:f01] 『ライカQ3 43』のF1仕様が販売開始 オートスポーツweb 2026年10月21日 15時51分 ドイツのカメラメーカーであるライカカメラ社とF1は10月21日、ライセンスパートナーシップの締結を発表した。 [e008:f02] また、同日より『ライカQ3 43 F1エディション』が販売開始となった。 [e008:f03] 『ライカQ3 43』をベースモデルとしたF1エディションは、ステアリングホイールを模した滑り止め加工のマイクロベロア素材のカバーを採用。 [e008:f04] さらに、トッププレートとレンズキャップにはF1のロゴがあしらわれている。 [e008:f05] さらに、カメラ本体に用いられている繊維模様は、軽量かつ高い剛性を兼ね備え、モータースポーツの世界で広く活用されている本物のカーボンが使用されている。 [e008:f06] なお、カーボンはこれまでのライカのカメラには使用されてこなかった素材だ。 [e008:f07] そして、『ライカQ3 43 F1エディション』専用として、モータースポーツにふさわしい画像表現を実現するためのLeica Look『Formula 1』が開発された。 [e008:f08] ライカは「コントラストを高め、彩度を強めることで、サーキットやパドックで感じられる雰囲気を、撮影した写真に忠実に再現する」としている。 [e008:f09] このルックは『Leica FOTOS』アプリで『ライカQ3 43 F1エディション』専用に提供される。 [e008:f10] 『ライカQ3 43 F1エディション』はライカストア、ライカオンラインストア、ライカブティックおよびライカ正規特約店にて2026年10月21日より発売されている。 [e008:f11] なお、ライカオンラインストアでの販売価格は1,595,000円（税込／2026年10月21日時点）となっている。
